title: PM’s I-Day speech — Reforms, AI skilling for youth, free online coaching and a warning on ‘dimagi Naxal’
description: In his 13th address to the nation, the first in 80 years that saw Vande Mataram preceding the national anthem, Narendra Modi directly spoke to some of the challenges facing India’s economy, security, and domestic anxieties, while evoking a ‘grave threat’ from ‘ideological Naxalites’
